CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.append_financial_fact_v3(input financial_fact_input_v3, caller_principal uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(fact_id uuid, recorded_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_now timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();
  v_id uuid:=extensions.gen_random_uuid();
  v_existing uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.internal_principal_role_is_exact_v3_internal($2,'opportunity_runner',v_now)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT403',MESSAGE='principal_role_unavailable'; END IF;
  IF ($1).filing_published_at>($1).source_timestamp
    OR ($1).source_timestamp>($1).collected_at
    OR ($1).collected_at>v_now
    OR (($1).estimate_kind='reported' AND (
      ($1).period_end>(($1).filing_published_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
      OR ($1).period_end>(($1).source_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date))
    OR char_length(btrim(($1).source_ref)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 120
    OR ($1).source_ref<>btrim(($1).source_ref)
    OR (
      (($1).provider IN ('mops','twse','tpex')
        AND ($1).authority_tier<>'official_filing')
      OR (($1).provider='finmind' AND ($1).authority_tier<>'finmind_mirror')
    )
    OR (
      ($1).fact_key IN (
        'monthly_revenue','quarterly_revenue','quarterly_gross_profit',
        'quarterly_operating_expense','quarterly_operating_income','quarterly_non_operating_income',
        'quarterly_pretax_income','quarterly_income_tax_expense','quarterly_noncontrolling_interest',
        'quarterly_net_income','quarterly_net_income_attributable_to_common','quarterly_ebitda',
        'depreciation_amortization','net_debt','cash_and_equivalents','total_debt','total_equity',
        'total_assets','invested_capital','net_asset_value','operating_cash_flow','capital_expenditure','interest_expense'
      ) AND ($1).unit NOT IN ('TWD','TWD_thousand','TWD_million')
    )
    OR (
      ($1).fact_key IN ('diluted_shares','diluted_weighted_average_shares','shares_outstanding')
      AND ($1).unit NOT IN ('share','thousand_shares')
    )
    OR (
      ($1).fact_key IN (
        'quarterly_diluted_eps','book_value_per_share','broker_target_price'
      )
      AND ($1).unit<>'TWD_per_share'
    )
    OR (($1).fact_key='roe' AND ($1).unit<>'percentage_points')
    OR (
      ($1).fact_key IN (
        'pe_multiple','pb_multiple','ev_ebitda_multiple','ev_sales_multiple'
      ) AND ($1).unit<>'dimensionless'
    )
    OR (
      ($1).duration_kind='instant' AND ($1).period_start IS NOT NULL
    )
    OR (
      ($1).duration_kind<>'instant'
      AND (($1).period_start IS NULL OR ($1).period_start>($1).period_end)
    )
    OR (
      ($1).estimate_kind='reported'
      AND (
        ($1).estimate_horizon<>'reported_period'
        OR ($1).fact_key='broker_target_price'
      )
    )
    OR (
      ($1).estimate_kind='analyst_estimate'
      AND (
        ($1).estimate_horizon<>'next_twelve_months'
        OR ($1).fact_key NOT IN (
          'quarterly_diluted_eps','quarterly_ebitda','quarterly_revenue',
          'book_value_per_share'
        )
      )
    )
    OR (
      ($1).estimate_kind='broker_consensus'
      AND (
        ($1).estimate_horizon<>'target_12m'
        OR ($1).fact_key<>'broker_target_price'
      )
    )
    OR (
      ($1).estimate_kind<>'reported'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.source_publication_verifications_v3 verification
        WHERE verification.evidence_ref=($1).source_ref
          AND verification.recorded_at<=v_now
          AND verification.collected_at<=v_now
          AND verification.institution_identity IS NOT NULL
      )
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='PT422',MESSAGE='invalid_authority_request';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(concat_ws('|',
    ($1).stock_id,($1).fact_key,coalesce(($1).period_start::text,''),
    ($1).period_end,($1).duration_kind
  ),0));
  SELECT fact.fact_id INTO v_existing
  FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 fact
  WHERE fact.stock_id=($1).stock_id
    AND fact.fact_key=($1).fact_key
    AND fact.period_start IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).period_start
    AND fact.period_end=($1).period_end
    AND fact.duration_kind=($1).duration_kind
    AND fact.value=($1).value
    AND fact.unit=($1).unit
    AND fact.provider=($1).provider
    AND fact.authority_tier=($1).authority_tier
    AND fact.estimate_kind=($1).estimate_kind
    AND fact.estimate_horizon=($1).estimate_horizon
    AND fact.filing_published_at=($1).filing_published_at
    AND fact.source_timestamp=($1).source_timestamp
    AND fact.collected_at=($1).collected_at
    AND fact.filing_restatement_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ($1).filing_restatement_id
    AND fact.source_ref=($1).source_ref
  ORDER BY fact.fact_id
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_existing IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT v_existing,fact.recorded_at
    FROM public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3 fact
    WHERE fact.fact_id=v_existing;
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_financial_facts_v3(
    fact_id,stock_id,fact_key,period_start,period_end,duration_kind,value,unit,provider,authority_tier,
    estimate_kind,estimate_horizon,filing_published_at,source_timestamp,collected_at,
    filing_restatement_id,source_ref,recorded_at
  ) VALUES(v_id,($1).stock_id,($1).fact_key,($1).period_start,($1).period_end,($1).duration_kind,
    ($1).value,($1).unit,($1).provider,($1).authority_tier,
    ($1).estimate_kind,($1).estimate_horizon,($1).filing_published_at,
    ($1).source_timestamp,($1).collected_at,($1).filing_restatement_id,($1).source_ref,v_now);
  INSERT INTO public.opportunity_rpc_audit_v3(
    function_name,caller_principal_id,subject_kind,subject_id,input_hash,
    disposition,recorded_at
  ) VALUES(
    'append_financial_fact_v3',$2,'financial_fact',v_id,
    encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(regexp_replace(jsonb_build_array(
      ($1).stock_id,($1).fact_key,($1).period_start,($1).period_end,
      ($1).duration_kind,($1).value,($1).unit,($1).provider,($1).authority_tier,
      ($1).estimate_kind,($1).estimate_horizon,
      ($1).filing_published_at,($1).source_timestamp,($1).collected_at,
      ($1).filing_restatement_id,($1).source_ref
    )::text,', ', ',', 'g'),'utf8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
    'appended',v_now
  );
  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_id,v_now;
END
$function$
